name: nyingarn
description: Convenience scripts for the docker compose development stack. Each service manages its own dependencies.

scripts.seed: docker compose exec rabbit-worker1 npm run seed --
scripts.load:datapacks: docker compose exec api npm run load:datapacks
scripts.test:api: docker compose exec api npm test --
scripts.test:tasks: docker compose exec rabbit-worker1 npm test --
scripts.build:ui: docker compose exec ui npm run build
scripts.build:ui-repository: docker compose exec ui-repository npm run build
scripts.psql: docker compose exec db psql -U root nyingarn
